samples.xml_description:
<module id="multi_pipe_4bit">
    <description>A 4-bit unsigned multiplier implemented with pipelined registers to store intermediate values and control the multiplication process.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal for synchronization.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal for chip reset.</input>
        <input id="mul_a" width_description="[3:0]">Multiplier multiplicand input signal.</input>
        <input id="mul_b" width_description="[3:0]">Multiplier multiplier input signal.</input>
        <output id="mul_out" width_description="[7:0]">Product output signal.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="size" value="4" description="Size parameter representing the bit width of the inputs and outputs."/>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <assign id="a_ext" value="{'{size{1'd0}}, mul_a}"/>
        <assign id="b_ext" value="{'{size{1'd0}}, mul_b}"/>
        <genvar id="i" begin_value="0" end_value="{size}" increment_value="1">
            <generate if_condition="i <= {size}">
                <assign id="partial_product_{i}" value="(b_ext[i] == 1'd1) ? (a_ext << i) : 'd0"/>
            </generate>
        </genvar>
        
        <reg id="register_sum_0" width_description="[7:0]"/> 
        <reg id="register_sum_1" width_description="[7:0]"/> 
        <reg id="register_sum_2" width_description="[7:0]"/> 
        <reg id="register_sum_3" width_description="[7:0]"/> 
        
        <always @(*) begin
            register_sum_0 = {'{size{1'd0}}, partial_product_0};
            register_sum_1 = {'{size{1'd0}}, partial_product_1};
            register_sum_2 = {'{size{1'd0}}, partial_product_2};
            register_sum_3 = {'{size{1'd0}}, partial_product_3};
            
            case(rst_n)
                1'd0: begin
                    register_sum_0 = 'd0;
                    register_sum_1 = 'd0;
                    register_sum_2 = 'd0;
                    register_sum_3 = 'd0;
                end
                default: begin
                    register_sum_0 = partial_product_0;
                    register_sum_1 = register_sum_0 + partial_product_1;
                    register_sum_2 = register_sum_1 + partial_product_2;
                    register_sum_3 = register_sum_2 + partial_product_3;
                end
            endcase
        end
        <reg id="product_reg" width_description="[7:0]"/>
        <always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (~rst_n) begin
                product_reg <= 'd0;
            end else begin
                product_reg <= register_sum_3;
            end
        end
        
        <assign id="mul_out" value="product_reg"/>
    </logic_description>
    
    <implementation>The multiplier implements a four-stage pipeline register structure, storing intermediate values and controlling the multiplication process.</implementation>
</module>
